import networkx as nx

# Create a circulant graph with 15 vertices
# Each vertex i is connected to (i±1), (i±2), (i±3) mod 15
G = nx.Graph()
n = 15
for i in range(n):
    for offset in [1, 2, 3]:
        j = (i + offset) % n
        if i < j:
            G.add_edge(i, j)
        j2 = (i - offset) % n
        if i < j2:
            G.add_edge(i, j2)

# Check the number of vertices and edges
print(f"Vertices: {G.number_of_vertices()}")
print(f"Edges: {G.number_of_edges()}")

# Check vertex connectivity
# vertex_connectivity returns the minimum number of nodes to remove to disconnect the graph
conn = nx.node_connectivity(G)
print(f"Vertex connectivity: {conn}")

# List the edges
edges = sorted(G.edges())
